name: Scheduled Program Pulse → coordinator (@pulse)
description: ADR-060 §7 (#272) + #268 scheduled Program Pulse rule. Fires on a cron schedule with an atomic inflight CAS guard and a 20h cooldown (persisted in RULE_SCHEDULES KV) to prevent overlapping or restart-storm runs. Ships with enabled: false by default in flow-bootstrap.json and e2e-flow-bootstrap.json so unconfigured or E2E environments do not fire background pulses unexpectedly; operators enable, disable, or adjust the schedule at runtime via Pattern-B RULE_CONFIG KV (rule.ConfigManager.SaveRule) without restarting the process. When enabled, dispatches an @pulse task to the coordinator, which classifies it as decide(action=research) and routes through the existing research pack (01-coordinator-research-spawn mints the research run → 02-plan-to-gather → 03a/03b → 04 → 07).

actions.subject: agent.task.coordinator
actions.prompt: @pulse Run the scheduled incremental Program Pulse across the configured portfolio (last scheduled fire: $schedule.last_fired_at). Route this request with decide(action="research", reason="Scheduled incremental Program Pulse across configured portfolio projects since $schedule.last_fired_at") so researcher-research-plan decomposes the portfolio into 1..4 project subtopics, researcher-research-gather reads incremental GitHub activity via github_read (distinguishing initial baseline onboarding, incremental deltas, no-change checks, and partial repository failures), and researcher-research-synthesize emits an evidence-backed Program Pulse artifact disclosing any unavailable repository surfaces in open_gaps.

metadata.iteration_budget_note: 8 allows the coordinator to classify the scheduled @pulse trigger and emit decide(action="research"). Conservative engineering default, not a successful-completion guarantee.
metadata.default_enabled_posture: Disabled on disk (enabled: false) by default; enabled and kill-switched live via Pattern-B RULE_CONFIG KV without process restart.
